name: quota-gauge
description: See your Claude plan usage at a glance: 5-hour session and weekly bars right above the prompt, with reset times and alerts.

show.title: Bars to show
show.description: Which usage windows appear above the prompt.

warnAt.title: Warning level (%)
warnAt.description: Bars turn red and the first alert fires at this usage. A last alert always fires at 95%.

alerts.title: Usage alerts
alerts.description: Notify me when a window reaches the warning level, and again at 95%.

timeFormat.title: Time format
timeFormat.description: How reset and pace times are written.
